sections.title: Core Concepts — AI-Powered Marketing Automation in Odoo 19

claims.text: Odoo 19.0 provides five primary marketing application modules: Email Marketing (mass_mailing), SMS Marketing (mass_mailing_sms), Social Marketing, Marketing Automation (marketing_automation), and Marketing Card.

Odoo 19.0 introduces a dedicated AI Platform (Productivity > AI) with features including AI Agents, Voice Transcription, AI Chatter Assistant, AI Fields, AI Server Actions, AI Live Chat, Web Page Content Generation, Document Auto-Sort, and a Business Insights Agent.
Predictive Lead Scoring uses a Naive Bayes machine-learning model trained on historical conversion data within the database to automatically calculate probability of winning each lead/opportunity.
IAP (In-App Purchases) services for marketing include Lead Generation (Lead Mining), Lead Enrichment, Partner Autocomplete, SMS sending, Snailmail, and Document Digitization.
IAP credits are purchased in packs and are NOT interchangeable between services — each service type has its own credit pool.
Enterprise users get free test credits for IAP services with a valid subscription.
The Marketing Automation module provides multi-step campaign workflows with triggers, filters, and actions (Email, SMS, Server Action).
Six pre-built Marketing Automation campaign templates ship with Odoo 19: Tag Hot Contacts, Welcome Flow, Double Opt-in, Commercial Prospection, Schedule Calls, and Prioritize Hot Leads.
The utm module provides a mixin (utm.mixin) that adds campaign_id, medium_id, and source_id fields to any model for marketing attribution tracking.

known_gaps: The specific LLM provider(s) used by the Odoo AI Platform are not documented in public sources
Pricing details for IAP credits (per-unit cost) are not publicly documented
The AI model training data retention policy is not documented in public sources

sections.title: Email Marketing (mass_mailing)

claims.text: Email Marketing in Odoo 19.0 supports drag-and-drop email building with reusable templates, A/B testing, scheduling, link tracking, and comprehensive statistics.

A/B Testing is built into Email Marketing with winner selection criteria: Manual, Highest Open Rate, Highest Click Rate, Highest Reply Rate, Leads Generated, Quotations Generated, and Revenues Generated.
Recipient targeting supports: Mailing List, Contact, Event Registration, Lead/Opportunity, Mailing Contact, and Sales Order — with custom filter logic (domain-based).
The mass_mailing module depends on: contacts, mail, html_builder, utm, link_tracker, social_media, web_tour, and digest.
Mailing lists support manual addition, CSV import, website newsletter signup blocks, and integration with Knowledge/Dashboards/Spreadsheets exports.
Email Marketing integrates with Marketing Automation campaigns for triggered and multi-step email sequences.
Blacklist management is built-in: unsubscribed recipients are tracked and excluded from future mailings.
Odoo 19.0 Email Marketing adds AI prompt integration in email templates for AI-generated email content.

known_gaps: No dedicated 'Smart Send Time' AI feature was found in documented Odoo 19 features
Email deliverability optimization strategies are not documented in Odoo docs (requires partner expertise)

sections.title: Marketing Automation Engine

claims.text: Marketing Automation campaigns organize participants as records engaged by the campaign workflow, with target audience defined by domain/filter expressions.
Three activity types are supported in workflows: Email (send automated emails), Server Action (execute internal database actions), and SMS (send text messages).
Campaign targets can include: Lead/Opportunity, Event Registration, Contact, and other models defined by filter/domain.
Email Marketing is required as a dependency for Marketing Automation; CRM is recommended; SMS Marketing is recommended.
The marketing_automation module depends on mass_mailing (Email Marketing) and extends it with campaign workflow capabilities.

known_gaps: Detailed trigger condition documentation (time-based vs behavioral) is limited in public docs
Campaign scalability limits (max participants per campaign) not documented

sections.title: Predictive Lead Scoring (PLS)

claims.text: PLS uses a Naive Bayes probability algorithm computed per sales team, with frequency tables (crm.lead.scoring.frequency) storing won_count/lost_count per (team_id, field, value).
Configurable PLS variables include: country_id, state_id, email_state, phone_state, source_id, tag_ids, and stage_id.
Probability computation uses batch SQL processing: PLS_COMPUTE_BATCH_STEP = 50000 and PLS_UPDATE_BATCH_STEP = 5000.
Training triggers occur when a lead is set to Won or Lost, calling _handle_won_lost() → _pls_increment_frequencies() with 0.1 fractional increments to avoid zero-probability issues.
A cron job (_cron_update_automated_probabilities) periodically rebuilds the frequency table and recomputes all automated probabilities.
Probabilities are clamped to ]0.01, 99.99[ for non-won/non-lost leads; won leads always = 100%, lost always = 0%.
Manual probability overrides are available (click the AI icon to revert to AI-computed value).

known_gaps: The exact Naive Bayes smoothing technique (beyond 0.1 fractional increments) is not fully documented
Model retraining frequency and triggers in detail are only in source code, not user docs

sections.title: IAP-Powered Intelligence Services

claims.text: Lead Mining (crm_iap_mine) generates leads from an external B2B database by searching criteria: country, state, industry, company size, role, seniority — outputs companies or companies+contacts at 1 credit per lead (+1 per contact).

Lead Enrichment (crm_iap_enrich) takes existing leads/contacts and fetches additional B2B data: business name, logo, size, revenue, social media accounts, technology used — at 1 credit per enrichment.
Lead Enrichment supports two modes: 'Enrich on demand only' (manual per-lead) or 'Enrich all leads automatically' (scheduled every 60 minutes via cron, minimum 5 min in dev mode).
Partner Autocomplete (partner_autocomplete) populates company info (name, logo, phone, email, tax ID, address, UNSPSC tags) as user types — at 1 credit per autocomplete request.
Partner Autocomplete works on new company contacts only and provides drop-down suggestions in real-time.
The base_iap module provides the core framework: IAP account model, credit management, and API integration with iap.odoo.com.
IAP services make HTTP requests to the IAP platform (iap.odoo.com), which validates credits, processes the request, and returns the result.
Low-credit email alerts can be configured per IAP service type.
Third parties can offer IAP services through the platform, extending the available service catalog.

known_gaps: The specific external B2B data provider(s) used by Lead Mining and Lead Enrichment are not named in public documentation
IAP credit pricing per service is not publicly documented (varies by region/service)
Data freshness/update frequency of the external B2B database is not documented

sections.title: Odoo 19 AI Platform

claims.text: Odoo 19.0 introduces a dedicated AI application module (ai_app) under Productivity, providing a comprehensive AI platform as a built-in Enterprise feature (no IAP required for the platform).
AI Agents can be customized with defined roles, instructions, knowledge sources, and guardrails for automated task handling.
AI Live Chat provides LLM-powered conversational capabilities on websites, built on top of the existing chatbot infrastructure.
Voice Transcription in meetings: Odoo AI transcribes conversations, organizes notes, and can translate content.
AI Chatter Assistant can draft emails, improve existing text, and summarize discussions in the Discuss/Chatter module.
Web Page Content Generation provides AI-generated first drafts when creating new web pages.
AI Fields are computed fields powered by AI, providing summaries, insights, or results from live searches into system data.
AI Server Actions enable AI-powered automated server actions for workflow automation.
The SEO page includes an 'Fill with AI' button that automatically generates meta titles, descriptions, and keyword suggestions.
Business Insights Agent allows natural-language queries about sales figures, performance analysis, forecasts, and trends.
Document Auto-Sort automatically assigns files to the correct folder and generates next actions.

known_gaps: The LLM provider(s) powering the AI Platform is not publicly documented by Odoo
Data privacy details (where AI inference runs — on-premises vs Odoo cloud) are not specified in public docs
API rate limits and throughput for AI Platform features are not documented
Custom model fine-tuning capabilities (if any) are not documented

sections.title: Chatbots and Conversational AI

claims.text: Odoo 19.0 provides script-driven conversational bots for Live Chat with step types: Text, Question, Email, Phone, Forward to Operator, Free Input/Multi-Line, Create Lead, and Create Ticket.
Chatbot scripts support conditional logic via 'Only If' field for if/then branching in conversation flows.
Chatbots can be configured to activate 'only when no operator is available' — acting as a fallback.
A sample 'Welcome Bot' chatbot script is provided with module installation.
Odoo 19.0 adds AI-powered Live Chat on top of the existing chatbot infrastructure, enabling LLM-based conversations.
Chatbots can be linked to specific Live Chat channels via Channel Rules configuration.

known_gaps: The distinction between rule-based chatbots and AI Live Chat in terms of which is used per channel is not fully detailed in public docs
Maximum script complexity/nesting depth is not documented

sections.title: Social Marketing & SMS Marketing

claims.text: Social Marketing supports Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and YouTube for post creation, scheduling, and publishing.
Social marketing campaigns allow multi-post campaign management with scheduling across platforms.
Social streams provide real-time feed monitoring for social listening and engagement.
SMS Marketing supports two backends: Odoo IAP SMS service (credit-based) or Twilio direct integration.
SMS Marketing includes mailing lists, blacklists, and performance tracking (delivery rates, opt-outs).
The mass_mailing_sms module extends mass_mailing with SMS-specific views and the sms module dependency.

known_gaps: TikTok and other emerging platform support status in Social Marketing is not confirmed in docs
SMS IAP pricing per destination country is not publicly documented

sections.title: Website Analytics, SEO, and Marketing Attribution

claims.text: Website Analytics supports integration with Plausible Analytics (privacy-focused) and Google Analytics for tracking page views, visits, conversions, and e-commerce metrics.
Link Tracker creates trackable short URLs with UTM parameters for campaign attribution, tracking clicks and click-through rates.
The link_tracker module depends on utm and mail, and supports unique short codes per link with click records (IP, country, timestamp).
SEO page features AI-powered content generation ('Fill with AI') for meta titles, descriptions, and keyword suggestions.
Marketing Attribution reports in CRM show which marketing campaigns/sources generated leads and revenue.
UTM tracking (utm.mixin) provides campaign, medium, and source attribution fields reusable across models.

known_gaps: Google Analytics 4 vs Universal Analytics support status is not explicitly documented
Multi-touch attribution models are not provided out-of-box (last-touch attribution via UTM is the default)

sections.title: Integrated Business Processes

claims.text: End-to-end lead generation pipeline: IAP Lead Mining → CRM scoring/assignment → Enrichment → Marketing Automation nurturing → Conversion tracking via UTM attribution.
Email Marketing A/B testing can select winners based on revenue generated, bridging marketing activities directly to sales outcomes.
Marketing Automation provides Double Opt-in campaign template for GDPR-compliant consent management.
Chatbots can create leads and tickets directly from website conversations, connecting marketing and sales workflows.
Loyalty programs (Coupons, Loyalty Cards, Promotions, Discount Codes, Buy X Get Y, Next Order Coupons) integrate with eCommerce and Point of Sale.
Website visitor tracking can identify visitors and link them to CRM leads/opportunities for personalized marketing follow-up.

known_gaps: Abandoned cart recovery is not a dedicated module — must be configured manually via marketing automation targeting eCommerce visitors
Customer referral programs are limited to HR/employee referrals, not a customer-facing referral program

sections.title: Technical Implementation Architecture

claims.text: Model hierarchy: utm (base) → link_tracker → mass_mailing → mass_mailing_sms; utm → crm → crm_iap_mine/crm_iap_enrich.

Key models: mailing.mailing (central mass mailing), mailing.list (contact groups), mailing.contact (subscribers), mailing.trace (per-recipient statistics), link.tracker (tracked URLs), link.tracker.click (click records).
mailing.mailing inherits mail.thread, mail.activity.mixin, mail.render.mixin, and utm.source.mixin for comprehensive framework integration.
crm.lead inherits mail.thread.cc, mail.thread.blacklist, mail.thread.phone, mail.activity.mixin, and utm.mixin.
utm.campaign is extended in mass_mailing with ab_testing fields and mailing_mail_ids relationships.
link.tracker and link.tracker.click are extended in mass_mailing with mass_mailing_id and mailing_trace_id fields.
Mass mailing uses _shorten_links (in mail.render.mixin) to convert email body links to tracked URLs automatically.
Statistics computation uses raw SQL (not Python loops) for _compute_statistics, _compute_clicks_ratio, _compute_link_trackers_count.
Failed mail retries use batch processing with batch_size=1000 to prevent cache overflow.
A/B testing uses random.sample() to select test recipients from the remaining recipient pool.
Predictive Lead Scoring (PLS) frequency table uses m2m relationship (crm.lead.scoring.frequency) with pre-computed won_count/lost_count per (team_id, variable, value).

known_gaps: Full API endpoint documentation for IAP service integration is not publicly available
Enterprise module source code is not publicly accessible for ai_app module details

sections.title: Security and Performance Considerations

claims.text: Mass mailing security: group_mass_mailing_user and group_mass_mailing_campaign groups control access; record rules protect mailing lists, contacts, and traces.
Blacklist system (mail.blacklist model) stores opted-out emails; mailing.contact inherits mail.thread.blacklist for automatic exclusion.
CRM security: team-based record rules in crm_security.xml, user assignment rules, and group_use_lead for lead vs opportunity-only mode.
PLS performance: Batch SQL processing with configurable batch sizes (50K compute, 5K update); frequency table is incrementally updated (not full recompute) on won/lost transitions.
Link Tracker uses _read_group aggregation for click count computation, minimizing SQL queries.
Cron-based sending for mass mailings uses ir_cron_mass_mailing_queue with _trigger() for scheduled departures.
Opt-out and seen-list caching pre-fetches data before sending batches to avoid repeated database queries.
Multi-company isolation is supported on marketing records via standard Odoo multi-company rules.

known_gaps: Email sending volume limits are not documented (depends on mail server configuration)
Marketing Automation campaign participant count limits are not documented

sections.title: Common Mistakes and Troubleshooting

claims.text: IAP credits are NOT interchangeable between services — attempting to use SMS credits for Lead Enrichment will fail.
Predictive Lead Scoring requires sufficient historical won/lost data to produce meaningful probabilities; fresh databases with no history will show default probabilities.
Automatic Lead Enrichment runs every 60 minutes by default — expecting immediate enrichment will lead to confusion.
Marketing Automation requires Email Marketing to be installed; attempting to use it without mass_mailing will fail at the dependency level.
Chatbot scripts are only active when assigned to a Live Chat channel via Channel Rules — creating a script without channel assignment results in no visible behavior.
Partner Autocomplete works only on new company contacts, not on existing contacts or individuals.
PLS probabilities are clamped to ]0.01, 99.99[ — so a lead will never show 0% or 100% unless manually won/lost.

known_gaps: Common email deliverability issues with Odoo's mass mailing are not covered in Odoo docs (requires SPF/DKIM setup knowledge)

sections.title: Testing Patterns

claims.text: Mass mailing tests cover: A/B testing, mailing internals, mailing lists, controllers, schedule dates, UI, UTM tracking, and retry logic.
CRM tests include: PLS-specific tests (test_crm_pls.py), lead conversion, lead merge, multi-company, activity management, assignment, and performance tests.
Marketing tests follow Odoo conventions: tagged with @tagged('post_install', '-at_install'), extend MailCommon, and use @patch for mocking external API calls.
PLS tests manipulate frequency tables directly and call _cron_update_automated_probabilities() to trigger recomputation without waiting for the cron scheduler.

known_gaps: Marketing Automation-specific test files were not found in source investigation
No documented test patterns for IAP service integration testing (mocking external APIs)

sections.title: Migration and Version Differences

claims.text: mass_mailing v2.7 in Odoo 19 added html_builder dependency and full asset bundles for the email builder.
The _shorten_links method moved to mail.render.mixin in Odoo 19 (was in link.tracker in earlier versions).
mailing.mailing._get_recipients_domain() now returns Domain objects instead of lists.
link_tracker.search_or_create() now expects a list of dicts (deprecated single dict).
Discuss channel types can be extended via channel_type selection_add; _to_store_defaults() pattern replaces polling for real-time updates.
The AI Platform (ai_app module) is entirely new in Odoo 19.0 with no equivalent in previous versions.
OCA modules on 18.0 branch need manual migration for Odoo 19 — no automated migration path exists.
sms module v3.0 in Odoo 19 has auto_install enabled, making SMS capabilities available without explicit installation.

known_gaps: Comprehensive migration guide from v18 to v19 for marketing modules is not available as a single document
Breaking changes in view/XML inheritance for marketing module views are not cataloged

sections.title: Troubleshooting Guide

claims.text: IAP service failures: Check IAP account has sufficient credits; verify network connectivity to iap.odoo.com; check that the IAP service is enabled in settings.
Predictive Lead Scoring not updating: Verify the PLS cron job is running; check that leads have been marked won/lost to generate training data; verify PLS fields are configured in Settings.
Email Marketing not sending: Check mail server configuration; verify recipient mailing lists have active contacts; check blacklist/exclusion filters; verify sending server is not rate-limited.
Chatbot not responding: Verify chatbot is assigned to a Live Chat channel via Channel Rules; check if 'enabled only if no operator' setting is blocking; test script steps for logic errors.
Marketing Automation campaign not progressing: Verify campaign is active; check participant filters match records; verify required dependencies (Email Marketing, SMS) are installed.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Email Marketing and Marketing Automation?
faqs.a: Email Marketing (mass_mailing) is for sending one-time or campaign-based emails to mailing lists with A/B testing. Marketing Automation (marketing_automation) creates multi-step automated workflows with triggers, filters, and conditional branching — combining email, SMS, and server actions into orchestrated sequences.

faqs.q: Do I need IAP credits to use Predictive Lead Scoring?
faqs.a: No. Predictive Lead Scoring is a built-in feature of the CRM module that uses a Naive Bayes model trained on your database's own historical data. No IAP credits are required.

faqs.q: Can I use my own OpenAI/Anthropic API key with Odoo's AI Platform?
faqs.a: Odoo 19.0 allows configuring AI API Keys in the AI settings. The exact supported providers are not detailed in public documentation. Testing with your own keys is recommended.

faqs.q: How do AI chatbots differ from rule-based chatbots in Odoo 19?
faqs.a: Rule-based chatbots use scripted decision trees with predefined steps and conditional branches. AI Live Chat (new in 19.0) uses LLM-based natural language conversations. Rule-based chatbots are appropriate for structured flows (FAQ, lead capture); AI chatbots handle open-ended conversations.

faqs.q: How are marketing email opens and clicks tracked?
faqs.a: A transparent tracking pixel is embedded in emails for open tracking. Links in email bodies are automatically converted to tracked URLs using the link_tracker module, which records click events with IP, country, and timestamp. Both are stored in mailing.trace records.

faqs.q: Can I A/B test social media posts?
faqs.a: A/B testing is built into Email Marketing, not Social Marketing. For social media, you would need to create multiple posts manually and compare their performance in the Social Marketing reports.

faqs.q: Does Odoo support abandoned cart email recovery?
faqs.a: There is no dedicated Abandoned Cart module. However, you can configure this manually using Website analytics to track cart abandonment and Marketing Automation to send follow-up emails to identified cart abandoners using Sales Order or eCommerce tracking data.

faqs.q: What are the costs of IAP services?
faqs.a: IAP credit pricing is not publicly documented — it varies by service, region, and volume. Enterprise users receive free test credits with a valid subscription. Credits are purchased in packs from the Odoo IAP Catalog within each database.

faqs.q: How do I set up GDPR-compliant double opt-in marketing?
faqs.a: Marketing Automation includes a 'Double Opt-in' pre-built campaign template. It sends a confirmation email to new recipients and only adds them to the mailing list after they click the confirmation link. This ensures explicit consent before marketing communications begin.

faqs.q: Can Predictive Lead Scoring use custom fields beyond the defaults?
faqs.a: Yes. The configurable PLS fields include country_id, state_id, email_state, phone_state, source_id, tag_ids, and stage_id. Additional fields can be added by extending the crm.lead.scoring.frequency.field model and updating the crm.pls_fields ir.config_parameter.
